title.en: jev-style 0.6.3: clearer local setup and training sources
title.zh: jev-style 0.6.3：统一本地安装与训练来源说明

text.en: Documentation-only release: clarify official local inference, TypeSafe teacher-label provenance, and separate hosted-service status. Runtime behavior, dependencies, model pins and weights are unchanged.
text.zh: 仅更新文档：明确官方本地推理、TypeSafe 教师软标签来源与独立的托管服务状态。运行行为、依赖、模型版本与权重不变。

text.en: Refreshed the PyPI description and added direct links to model selection and benchmark protocols. Runtime behaviour is unchanged.
text.zh: 更新 PyPI 说明，加入模型选择和评测协议入口，运行行为不变。

text.en: Added runnable support-ticket, fallback-routing and receipt-review recipes, plus a Semantic Router example.
text.zh: 新增工单、回退路由和收据核对示例，以及 Semantic Router 集成示例。

text.en: The first Jev-Style model that reads images, through its PyTorch build. MLX and GGUF builds are text-only.
text.zh: 第一个能读图片的 Jev-Style 模型（PyTorch 版），MLX 和 GGUF 版仅支持文本。

text.en: Added 2B v4 and image requests. --release 2b now selects 2B v4; the default release stays 0.8B v3.
text.zh: 加入 2B v4 和图片请求。--release 2b 现在指向 2B v4，默认版本仍是 0.8B v3。

text.en: Added compressed request bodies and tighter request checks for compatibility with current official SDKs.
text.zh: 支持压缩请求体并收紧请求校验，兼容当前官方 SDK。

text.en: A cascade configuration: our 2B answers first and sends uncertain questions to a larger model.
text.zh: 级联配置：2B 先作答，没把握的问题交给更大的模型。

text.en: Added CUDA graphs for the PyTorch backend and confidence cascades across model tiers.
text.zh: PyTorch 后端加入 CUDA graphs，并支持按置信度分层的级联。

text.en: Released with PyTorch, MLX and GGUF builds, and available through jev-style 0.3.0.
text.zh: 发布 PyTorch、MLX 和 GGUF 版本，可通过 jev-style 0.3.0 使用。

text.en: The package became installable with pip and gained an eval command for comparing engines on your own questions.
text.zh: 可用 pip 安装，并新增在自己的题目上对比引擎的 eval 命令。

text.en: Shipped a local API server, six agent skills, a Claude Code guard, an MCP server and an evaluation command.
text.zh: 提供本地 API 服务、六个 Agent 技能、Claude Code 审核钩子、MCP 服务和评测命令。

text.en: A smaller long-input, multilingual model, and the default local text model today.
text.zh: 更小的长输入多语言模型，也是目前默认的本地文本模型。

text.en: A 322M decision model for local Mac agents.
text.zh: 面向本地 Mac Agent 的 322M 决策模型。
2B 规模、概率校准的英文分类模型。

text.en: The first published decision model. Superseded by v3 and v4.
text.zh: 首个公开的决策模型，已由 v3 和 v4 取代。
